description.blurb: 2135 Aristaeus is an Apollo asteroid discovered on April 17, 1977 at Palomar Observatory. It is named for Aristaeus, the son of Apollo and the nymph Cyrene.
description.more: 2135 Aristaeus is a potentially hazardous asteroid because its minimum orbit intersection distance is less than 0.05 AU and its diameter is greater than 150 meters. The Earth-MOID is 0.0100 AU (1,500,000 km; 930,000 mi), or about 3.9 lunar distances.
